pattern: ^SELECT .+ FROM Professionals AS p JOIN \(\s*SELECT professional\_id\s*\w+\s*\*\s*FROM Treatments GROUP BY professional\_id HAVING COUNT\(*\)\s*AS t ON p\.professional\_id = t\.professional\_id WHERE .+
correction: First filter by state for professionals and then join the professionals with their respective treatments, grouping them to select only those professionals who have performed more than 2 treatments.

metadata.description: This rule identifies incorrect joins between Professionals and Treatments tables, where the join condition is not properly defined or filtered.
